description: Pakistan Oilfields Limited (POL) is an oil and gas exploration and production company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and a subsidiary of The Attock Oil Company Limited, incorporated in 1950. In addition to exploring for and producing crude oil and gas, its plants manufacture LPG, solvent oil and sulphur, and it markets LPG under its own POLGAS brand as well as through its subsidiary Capgas (Private) Limited. It also operates a network of pipelines transporting its own and other companies' crude oil to Attock Refinery Limited.
sourceNote: Written from: pakoil.com.pk — company overview / company information pages and the Profiles of Directors PDF linked from the site's downloads (accessed 2026-10-17)
